name: Wells Fargo Choice Privileges Select Mastercard

localized_names.en: Wells Fargo Choice Privileges Select Mastercard

apr.notes: APR not displayed on product page; see Important Credit Terms / Account Agreement for current rates.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee: 'When you use your card for travel, you won't pay a foreign currency conversion fee for purchases converted to U.S. dollars.'

categories.label: Choice Hotels stays and Choice Privileges point purchases
Gas stations, grocery stores, home improvement stores, and phone plan services

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeemable for reward nights at select Choice Hotels properties.

signup_bonus.description: EARN 60,000 BONUS POINTS when you spend $3,000 in purchases in the first 3 months - enough to redeem for up to 7 reward nights at select Choice Hotels properties.

benefits.title: Anniversary Bonus
benefits.description: Earn 30,000 bonus points every account anniversary, enough to redeem up to 3 reward nights at Choice Hotels properties.

benefits.title: Automatic Platinum Elite Membership
benefits.description: Receive 20 Elite Qualifying Nights guaranteeing you Choice Privileges Platinum Elite status and benefits each calendar year.

benefits.title: Trusted Traveler Program
benefits.description: Enroll in a Trusted Traveler Program (such as Global Entry or TSA PreCheck) and receive one statement credit up to $120 every four years as reimbursement for the application or renewal fee charged to your Choice Privileges Select Mastercard.

benefits.title: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Get up to $800 of cell phone protection against damage or theft when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with your Choice Privileges Select Mastercard (subject to a $25 deductible).

benefits.title: Mastercard World Elite Benefits
benefits.description: Get access to additional security benefits, exclusive offers, concierge, travel & lifestyles services, and more.

benefits.title: Milestone Rewards
benefits.description: Earn rewards more frequently throughout the year - such as bonus points or gift cards.

benefits.title: Fast Track Your Status and Rewards
benefits.description: Upgrade to higher Choice Privileges Elite status and earn rewards faster with points earned using your card on everyday purchases.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Choice Privileges Platinum Elite (20 Elite Qualifying Nights/year)
other: Trusted Traveler Program statement credit up to $120 every four years
